text:
claire: @channel Heads-up: we're running a NEARLINE cache warmup probe this Saturday 03:00-04:00 UTC across eu/west/usw regions. This is a prefill/validation pass to reduce cold-start p99s during the upcoming promo. No planned API downtime, but you may see short p95/p99 blips and occasional 502s while we rotate warmers. :warning:

aj: What's the exact blast radius? will this touch Dedicated GPU pools?

claire: No GPU pool restarts. This only hits the nearline prefix caches (kvcache-prefill jobs) and the warmup read path. Impact: transient token latency increases for requests that miss primary cache and hit origin while warmup runs. Expected >95% unaffected.

dominique: Can we get the runbook link and the grafana dashboard? posting for on-call.

claire: Runbook: https://confluence.internal/ops/nearline-warmup-runbook (see steps 2-5 for rollback). Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/ops/nearline-cache?orgId=1

sre-bot: Scheduled job created: kvcache-prefill-probe-2026-11-06-0300 UTC. JobID: prefill-3112223333. Ping @eng-oncall 15m before start.

eli: I'll add a heartbeat monitor and a synthetic check to detect >2min sustained p95 spike; will also attach a zap alert to paging rules.

aj: Can we set a temporary SLO relaxation window? Recommend bumping regional token p99 SLO from 1200ms -> 1800ms for the 1h window to avoid automated rollbacks.

claire: Yes — proposing SLO reslice for that window only. ops-lead can confirm. SLO change will be recorded in the incident repo and reverted automatically after 04:15 UTC.

ops-lead: Confirmed. Applying temporary SLO window: 03:00-04:15 UTC; auto-revert at 04:15. No customer-facing notice needed.

dominique: Copy. I'll standby with rollback commands. Quick reminder to oncall: rollback = stop prefill job + flush nearline prefix + rehydrate traffic to default route. Snippet:

```
# stop job
kubectl -n infra delete cronjob prefill-3112223333
# flush prefix
redis-cli -h nearline-redis flushprefix cache:nearline:region:eu
# revert route
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/routing/revert -d '{"route":"nearline-prefill"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL'
```

eli: I'll post the synthetic link in #eng-oncall 15m before.

claire: Thanks all. Post-mortem if we see >5% error surge or >10min elevated p95. Otherwise we'll log a short note in the ops changelog. :thumbsup:

aj: A few folks asked about capacity — prefill uses low-priority workers and backs off on CPU >70%. Should be safe.

sre-bot: Reminder to oncall: runbook ack required 10m before start.

dominique: Acked. I'll be watching the dashboard.

claire: Closing thread for now; will ping again 30m and 5m before start.
